name: ICustomTaskPaneConsumer
description: An interface that provides access to the CTPFactoryAvailable method that is used to create an instance of a custom task pane.

methods.name: CTPFactoryAvailable
methods.description: Passes an ICTPFactory object to a Microsoft ActiveX add-in that can then be used when creating a custom task pane.

parameters.name: CTPFactoryInst
parameters.description: The object is used by an add-in to create a task pane.
